reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 13 and targeted source panel crop, complete unchanged external-02 2048x2048 raw RGBA and native face/beard and note/right-edge crops, full repair-agent white/cyan/alpha sheet and evidence, and unchanged naiwa.png; verified actual yellow mascot conversion, broad source beard continuity, restored dark right tab, two note lines, suit/pocket detail, collar, backing and transparency.

entries.positive_observation: External-02 is now a genuine Naiwa conversion with a compact rounded YELLOW head, green-ringed black eyes and a short broad mascot neck, not the prior photorealistic human skin/eyes. Slicked-back dark brown-black hair and strong separate dark brows remain. The grey moustache and broad connected short grey beard cover the lower cheeks beside the mouth and continue across both jaw sides and chin, rather than a detached goatee; the upper cheek boundary remains smooth yellow. The slight left three-quarter pose and one stern closed mouth remain. The black suit, white pointed collar, dark tie and one small white triangular lower-left pocket detail remain, with a fitted short broad collar and no stalk or pinching. A dark right-edge note tab is restored, and the note has TWO compact upper mark lines with mostly blank lower paper. The complete dark frame and opaque dark blue-grey backplate remain. Full white/cyan inspection shows a genuine transparent exterior without visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA extrema 0..254 after actual white/cyan/alpha inspection; no source-alpha replacement was performed or needed, and 252-254 values alone were not rejection grounds.
entries.visible_limitations: Individual beard hairs, the exact tiny pocket-detail shape and note lettering are unresolved at 65x67; the review verifies the visible mascot identity, broad beard boundary, two-line footprint, right-tab structure and outfit/collar features without claiming microscopic hair or glyph identity.
